violation_summary: CEI pattern violation: External call (line 16) occurs before state updates (lines 18-19), enabling reentrancy attack. An attacker's fallback function can re-enter withdrawFunds() and drain funds before balance is set to zero.
recommendation: Move state updates before external call: set balances[msg.sender] = 0 and orderStatus = Status.COMPLETED before the .call{value: amount}(). Alternatively, use a ReentrancyGuard modifier.
